title: Remaining open Master Plan findings — NOT closed
method: Honest inventory of open work on the orchestration master plan after the P0-2 / P1-B repair gates. Nothing in this matrix is claimed complete; each entry records the open scope and the current disposition.
summary: The P0-2 production-isolation and P1-B final repair gates are closed, but the Master Plan as a whole is NOT complete. The items below remain open and require follow-up before full completion can be claimed.

open_items.title: fdx-secure-exec trusted package boundary
open_items.description: Secure-execution trusted-package boundary for the fdx native binary remains open.

open_items.title: macOS/Windows secure execution
open_items.description: Secure execution parity on macOS and Windows remains open (current gates cover CI matrix execution of the packed CLI, not OS-native secure execution).

open_items.title: Routing Tasks 5-12
open_items.description: Routing work items 5-12 from the master plan remain unimplemented/unverified.

open_items.title: Windows daemon IPC
open_items.description: Windows daemon inter-process communication path remains open (daemon IPC is validated on Linux only so far).

open_items.title: PR #112 cache transaction semantics
open_items.description: PR #112 cache transaction semantics (deferred visibility / atomic publish / reuse revalidation) require final review and closure evidence.

open_items.title: verify:production authority
open_items.description: The verify:production gate (scripts/verify-production.mjs) has not been run to closure on this branch; its authority over release readiness remains unproven here.

open_items.title: Phase 0-12 traceability + remaining P1/P2 evidence
open_items.description: Full phase 0-12 traceability matrix and the remaining P1/P2 evidence artifacts are not yet produced for this branch.
